additional_concerns: Candidate node.ad3ed6f7c586444ec7213491 adds nav > 0 to legal scope without support in the circular. Nonpositive NAV returns OUT_OF_SCOPE; missing NAV returns UNKNOWN even with an established applicable SFC designation. A measurement-validity condition should not silently exclude a covered Fund or disable the independent designation route.

The first candidate's doubled exposure sum correctly implements the inclusive 50% comparison in the declared exact common units: 2E >= NAV is equivalent to E >= NAV/2. This does not establish the legal measurement convention for nonpositive NAV or validate exposure inputs.

Both candidates delegate exposure identification and measurement. The first refers to a supplied methodology, but none is included. Valuation, look-through, derivative exposure, netting, double counting and assessment dates remain unresolved. The second expressly retains UNKNOWN when the measurement basis is unresolved.

Footnote 7 places the holistic designation assessment in cases below 50%. Both candidates require an actual applicable SFC designation, rather than converting non-exhaustive risk factors into automatic designation. Their OR preserves affirmative classification when either route is established; it does not implement or authorize exercise of SFC discretion.

The global runtime CONFLICT rule can withhold a result despite a separately established sufficient route. This is an engineering withholding policy, not a classification condition stated by the circular. PRESERVES assessments below concern consistent inputs at the declared interface.

Neither candidate resolves classification persistence after exposure falls below 50%, temporary crossings or designation effective dates. FALSE must retain the stated limited meaning and cannot authorize declassification, distribution or a comprehensive compliance finding.

The LAF exclusion concerns the assessed Fund itself, not every intermediary holding. If category membership is unresolved, the separate LAF circular referenced in footnote 6 may be needed; no identifiable dependency mapping or text is supplied.
All supplied external dependency hashes are null and their authority identities are unspecified. None qualifies as AVAILABLE; mapping them to particular authorities would invent a catalogue match.

OMITS for upstream definitions records delegated assessment, not an established defect in the Boolean combination. NOT_APPLICABLE findings retain substantive duties outside these classification questions and do not authorize pruning them.
